review.notes: Structure: all 40 bare $$ display-math delimiters pair into 20 well-formed blocks (n, n+2), the three ```json blocks are one-to-three-line printed transcripts, and no code fence swallows headings, tables or images. Full text-layer diff of all 40 physical pages plus a word-coverage sweep and a numeric-multiset comparison; rendered physical pages 4, 5 and 33 were visually inspected and confirm every equation patch. Confirmed repairs: one dropped footnote body (LingoJudge/LingoScore) and OCR-spaced digits inside eight display equations ((4), (5), (6), (8), (17), (18), (19)). Dropped numbers on p10/p23 are axis and legend labels of embedded Figures 5/11 and the cover arXiv stamp is dropped by convention across sibling arXiv readers; author and contributor lists on p25 are present. The printed 'Pertraining' strings belong to the Figure-2/Figure-4 artwork.
